assumptions.choice: When an extreme value occurs more than once in the 200-bar window, use its most recent occurrence to determine whether the swing high preceded the swing low.
assumptions.reason: The specification defines extreme values but does not specify tie handling for their occurrence order.

assumptions.choice: A swing range is identified by its high and low values and their selected bar occurrences; the entry state resets when any of these changes.
assumptions.reason: This applies the required once-per-swing-range state machine while levels are recomputed dynamically.

assumptions.choice: No setup processing occurs when the 200-bar swing high equals the swing low.
assumptions.reason: Retracement levels are undefined without a nonzero range.
